responsibility: This header declares gm2’s low-level tree utility API: predicates for variable, array, type, ordinal, and constant nodes; helpers to skip type, const, and reference wrappers; a tree-overflow query; and a debug dump routine. It is the C declaration side of the simple GCC tree normalization helpers implemented in m2tree.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2tree group: it declares the native tree predicates, skip helpers, and related macros such as SET_WORD_SIZE, while m2tree.def is the Modula-2-facing specification and m2tree.cc implements the logic.
